title: AAOS Agent Registry
description: Static roster of AAOS agents. Exactly 2 entries (claude-code, cowork) are seeded later, not by this schema itself.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Consumer: tools/validate.py (rejects a mismatched major version with a pointer to docs/MIGRATIONS.md).

generated_by.description: Human author note. Consumer: OPERATIONS.md reader.

agents.description: Static roster of agents. Consumer: tools/validate.py (registry-membership checks against every task/handoff/event actor reference), lease-task.py and post-handoff.py (agent resolution), COWORK-BOOTSTRAP.md dry-run, project-notion.py (row labels).

id.description: Open identifier, not an enum — onboarding agent #3+ must be possible by adding a registry entry alone, with no schema edit (Phase 1 design-review finding: an enum here contradicted the 'add one entry, nothing else changes' extensibility guarantee). Membership/existence checks against this id happen at tools/validate.py (registry-membership check), not in this schema. Consumer: lease-task.py owner match, post-handoff.py from/to resolution, every event actor.

surface.description: Consumer: project-notion.py row labels + human reader.

capabilities.description: Open vocabulary (not an enum), e.g. filesystem/git/notion/excel/underwriting/email-draft — a new agent may bring a capability string never seen before without a schema edit. Consumer: a human/agent choosing suggested_next_owner (advisory) + validate.py routing sanity.

reachable_paths.description: Each a path/glob. Consumer: COWORK-BOOTSTRAP dry-run (verifies each path resolves) + validate.py seam sanity.

write_scope.description: Each a path glob. The ownership boundary. Load-bearing field. Consumer: tools/validate.py — any handoff/task artifact path outside the poster's write_scope fails validation, loud flag.

heartbeat_source.description: One or more upstream signals to project for this agent (e.g. cowork has two: the Notion heartbeat page's last_edited_time, and the automation-health-monitor beacon table — ADR-0005). Consumer: derive-heartbeat.py.

active.description: Consumer: derive-heartbeat.py (an inactive agent's heartbeat status is forced to unknown regardless of signal data). NOT consumed by expire-leases.py directly -- reclamation is expiry-based, independent of this flag; an inactive agent's expired lease is reclaimed the same way any expired lease is.
